summary: Published posts: replace Archive with Unpublish (back to draft) to close the archive trap-door
description: On published posts the only action was Archive, which was effectively one-way (publish route requires status='draft', so archived posts couldn't return). Replace it with Unpublish: setStatus gains a guarded 'draft' target (only from published/archived; clears published_at), POST /api/admin/blog/[id]/unpublish, PublishedActions shows Unpublish. The post leaves public view (list cache TTL) and reappears in Drafts — editable + re-publishable. Verified loop live: published->unpublish->draft->publish->published.

resolution.note: Published posts now Unpublish->draft (guarded 'draft' target, clears published_at). Loop verified live.
